用于面部恢复的 ComfyUI Face Detailer 工作流程

你可以轻松运行这个ComfyUI 面部细节设计工作流程在运行舒适，专为 ComfyUI 量身定制的基于云的平台。所有必要的节点和模型均已预设并可立即使用！

另外，您还可以在以下位置找到许多其他出色的 ComfyUI 工作流程：润康网站.

ComfyUI 工作流程通过 Impact Pack-Face Detailer 和 4x UltraSharp 模型增强图像和视频质量。 Face Detailer 通过先进的面部检测和细节增强来改善面部特征，而 4x UltraSharp 模型则可放大图像，在不损失质量的情况下提高分辨率。总之，此工作流程非常适合需要详细面部修复和清晰度的高分辨率视觉项目。

FaceDetailer简介

Face Detailer 是 ComfyUI Impact Pack 的一部分，通过集成检测和细化面部细节的工具来简化图像增强。

FaceDetailer 的主要特点

  • 自动面部增强：自动检测并增强面部，非常适合恢复低分辨率图像的细节。

  • 多遍细化：使用两个 FaceDetailer 通道修复严重受损的面部，从而实现详细重建。

  • 背景保存：将人脸检测与轮廓分割相结合，在不扭曲背景的情况下增强人脸效果。

ComfyUI Face Detailer Workflow for Face Restore

You can easily run thisComfyUI Face Detailer WorkflowinRunComfy, a cloud-based platform tailored specifically for ComfyUI. All essential nodes and models are pre-set and ready for immediate use!

Plus, you'll find plenty of other great ComfyUI Workflows on theRunComfy website.

The ComfyUI workflow enhances image and video quality through the Impact Pack-Face Detailer and the 4x UltraSharp Model. The Face Detailer improves facial features with advanced face detection and detail enhancement, while the 4x UltraSharp Model upscales images, enhancing resolution without losing quality. Together, this workflow is ideal for high-resolution visual projects requiring detailed facial restoration and clarity.

Introduction to FaceDetailer

The Face Detailer, part of ComfyUI's Impact Pack, simplifies image enhancement by integrating tools for detecting and refining facial details.

Key Features of FaceDetailer

  • Automatic Facial Enhancement:Automatically detects and enhances faces, ideal for restoring detail in low-resolution images.

  • Multi-Pass Refinement:Uses two FaceDetailer passes for repairing severely damaged faces, allowing for detailed reconstruction.

  • Background Preservation:Combines face detection with silhouette segmentation to enhance faces without distorting the background.
